issues.title: Verify the hosted Supabase publication journey
issues.description: Connect a development Supabase project and exercise the full signed-in workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Apply migration and seed to a development project.
Create researcher/admin/student accounts through trusted provisioning.
Capture submit → review → publish → anonymous read and negative role tests.

issues.title: Add connected search across research entities
issues.description: Extend title search to areas, researchers, projects and publications without leaking private rows.
acceptanceCriteria: Search returns grouped entity results with useful links.
RLS prevents private submissions from appearing.
Empty query, special characters and zero results are tested.

issues.title: Connect research area pages to people and publications
issues.description: Expand the existing area-to-project preview into a connected discovery page.
acceptanceCriteria: Show linked researchers and published outputs via relationship tables.
Preserve DEMO DATA and mobile layouts.
Each entity has a useful next action.

issues.title: Create public researcher detail pages
issues.description: Give a public researcher identity context and connected work.
acceptanceCriteria: Unique slug route shows biography and public projects/publications.
Private profile data and unpublished outputs remain hidden.
Missing records and demo labels are handled.

issues.title: Create public project detail pages
issues.description: Explain a project with its areas, people and published outputs.
acceptanceCriteria: Slug route shows project purpose and lifecycle status.
Link relevant areas, researchers and published outputs.
Keyboard and mobile navigation work.

issues.title: Add researcher edit and resubmit screens
issues.description: Expose the existing draft/change-request permissions through a small edit flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Only owners can edit Draft or Changes Requested.
Resubmission changes status to Submitted and locks edits.
Direct API and action attempts against other states are tested.

issues.title: Add review feedback and reviewer attribution
issues.description: Explain requested changes and rejection with a visible review note.
acceptanceCriteria: Coordinate an additive migration for review note and reviewer.
Researcher sees the review feedback on their own record.
Review notes stay private and cannot be changed by researchers.

issues.title: Create expression-of-interest database and action
issues.description: Let authenticated students express interest in one project with private contact context.
acceptanceCriteria: Coordinate minimal interest schema and RLS.
Validate and deduplicate submissions.
Only owner and authorized admin can read private interest records.

issues.title: Build Get Involved entry and interest form
issues.description: Provide a clear participation action from project detail.
acceptanceCriteria: Public information remains accessible without login.
Account required only when submitting interest.
Show accessible validation, pending and confirmation states.

issues.title: Show role-relevant dashboard next actions
issues.description: Replace generic next steps with counts and actionable status links.
acceptanceCriteria: Counts reflect the signed-in role and current records.
Change requests link to editing and feedback.
Admin queue shows meaningful empty and error states.

issues.title: Audit responsive and keyboard journeys
issues.description: Make core discovery and dashboard journeys usable on mobile and by keyboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Check 375px and desktop layouts without horizontal overflow.
Labels, focus order and feedback are usable without a mouse.
Capture representative screenshots and fix critical issues.

issues.title: Rehearse and record the demo acceptance journey
issues.description: Prove the integrated hackathon workflow and prepare a fallback demonstration.
acceptanceCriteria: Run lint, types, tests and production build on frozen main.
Rehearse anonymous → researcher → admin → anonymous in separate sessions.
Check all fictional records have DEMO DATA; save backup screenshots.

issues.title: Add Needs Attention and freshness queries
issues.description: Prioritize stale reviews and incomplete research records.
acceptanceCriteria: Define a small set of actionable stale/incomplete rules.
Admin-only results link to affected records.
No invented analytics or exposed private records.

issues.title: Create a minimal event management slice
issues.description: Model an admin-managed event with optional external registration.
acceptanceCriteria: Add coordinated schema, RLS and admin form for title/date/URL.
Validate external URLs and label outbound registration.
Public event summary preserves demo labels.

issues.title: Create a minimal opportunity management slice
issues.description: Let admins publish a small opportunity record with an application direction.
acceptanceCriteria: Coordinate schema and admin-only mutations.
Show public deadline, description and next action.
Expired opportunities are clearly indicated.

issues.title: Prototype grant directory schema and read view
issues.description: Document and display the minimum information needed for grants.
acceptanceCriteria: Agree minimal fields before migrating.
Only admins curate; public records are explicitly public.
Seed only clearly marked demonstration records.

issues.title: Add in-app review notifications
issues.description: Notify a researcher when a review decision changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Owner-only notification reads and mark-read action.
Generate notifications transactionally or document reliable delivery.
No email integration required for this slice.

issues.title: Add basic admin counts from real records
issues.description: Replace the analytics shell with a few useful database-derived counts.
acceptanceCriteria: Counts show published outputs, pending reviews and projects.
Admin-only queries are enforced and empty states are honest.
No fabricated metrics or large chart dependencies.

issues.title: Define researcher profile update review flow
issues.description: Design a reviewed profile change request without direct institutional publishing.
acceptanceCriteria: Document minimal requested-change schema and transitions.
Researcher proposes changes; admin decides publication.
Add permission tests for proposed data access.

issues.title: Evaluate semantic search with a public-only dataset
issues.description: Timebox a feasibility study after the demo-critical paths work.
acceptanceCriteria: Compare keyword search against a small public test set.
Document cost, privacy and infrastructure tradeoffs.
No production embeddings added without team decision.

issues.title: Design a cited public research assistant
issues.description: Explore a grounded assistant that points back to published evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Specify citations, refusal/unknown behavior and public data boundary.
Create a small reviewable interaction sketch.
Record evaluation criteria before choosing an AI SDK.

issues.title: Evaluate admin recommendations and personalization
issues.description: Explore useful recommendations without opaque institutional decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: Identify two actionable suggestions with explanations.
Document privacy and opt-in requirements for personalization.
Keep approval and publication human-controlled.

issues.title: Scope partners and richer integrations
issues.description: Plan a partner directory and one useful integration without expanding bootstrap.
acceptanceCriteria: Document partner relationships and public/private fields.
Identify one integration with source ownership and failure behavior.
Break implementation into bounded follow-up issues.
